newsitem.title: CHINA: China revokes licences of seven futures brokers.
newsitem.headline: China revokes licences of seven futures brokers.

text.p: China's top securities and futures watchdog has revoked the business licences of seven futures brokerages after they failed an annual examination, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) had found that some of the brokerages had not done any business for six months, some had not submitted seasonal business reports as required, some had held their staff back from taking an annual examination, the newspaper said.
The CSRC revoked the business licences of another 11 futures brokerages earlier this month due to heavy debts and irregularities, official media has reported.
